Rae T.: Quick heads upI submitted a small docs PR updating SDK snippets for streaming/pagination retries across Python/TS/Go: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210
Omar V.: Glance incoming. What's the scope?
Rae T.: Add Deno + Node variants for streaming resume tokens, clarify base64 decoding, tighten Go context cancel example, and show a compact Python async iterator with simple backoff. Kept production notes short.
Nina K.: Can you paste the Node vs Deno token decode examples here? I want to copy the wording.
Rae T.: Node:
```js
// Node: resume token base64 decode
const decoded = Buffer.from(token, 'base64').toString();
// pass `decoded` as cursor on next request
```
Deno:
```ts
// Deno: atob available in runtime
const decoded = atob(token);
```
Omar V.: Good to show both. Add a one-liner: "Some runtimes return raw cursors; only decode if the token looks base64."
Rae T.: Added that. Also added a tiny Python example showing async iteration + a naive jittered backoff. Defaults are small for readability.
Nina K.: Linting note: prettier will want semicolons in some TS examples; black will reformat the Python code block. I can push a formatting commit after merge if needed.
